dedupe_keys.name: bushehr harbour lorawan rssi and snr localization measurements

description: This deposit contains LoRaWAN signal measurements from an outdoor testbed at Bushehr harbour, Iran. The research team deploys three gateways, a mobile GPS-equipped end node and two fixed end nodes to study localization in a humid, changing industrial environment. The Excel file records RSSI and signal-to-noise information, node identifiers and timestamps for received packets. Zenodo provides free CC BY 4.0 access. The filename includes an October 2022 date, but the short metadata do not establish the complete campaign duration or a uniform packet interval. Coverage is one harbour radio geometry, and environmental dependence limits transfer of fitted signal models to other ports. A reviewer-assessed use is calibrating signal-strength or localization assumptions for port IoT simulations. platform-ns-3 is a related network-simulation environment, but a compatible LoRaWAN extension and import were not tested. No measurements were downloaded or location estimator run.
name: Bushehr harbour LoRaWAN RSSI and SNR localization measurements
